    n, k, x = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

    pos = [ai for ai in a if ai > 0]
    neg = [ai for ai in a if ai < 0]

    pos.sort()
    neg.sort(reverse=True)

    def min_product_with_k_operations(n, k, x, pos, neg):
        changes = 0
        while changes < k:
            if not pos and not neg:
                break
            if not pos:
                if len(neg) >= 2:
                    if neg[0] + x <= neg[1] - x:
                        neg[0] += x
                    else:
                        neg[0] -= x
                    changes += 1
                elif len(neg) == 1:
                    neg[0] -= x
                    changes += 1
                break
            if not neg:
                if len(pos) >= 2:
                    if pos[0] - x >= pos[1] + x:
                        pos[0] -= x
                    else:
                        pos[0] += x
                    changes += 1
                elif len(pos) == 1:
                    pos[0] += x
                    changes += 1
                break

            if pos[0] - x >= neg[0] + x:
                neg[0] += x
                changes += 1
            else:
                pos[0] += x
                changes += 1

        b = []
        for ai in a:
            if ai > 0:
                b.append(pos.pop(0))
            elif ai < 0:
                b.append(neg.pop(0))
            else:
                b.append(ai)
        return b

    b = min_product_with_k_operations(n, k, x, pos, neg)
    print(" ".join(map(str, b)))
